name: qijuan
description: 栖卷 QiJuan — a self-hosted personal ebook library.

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm test --workspace server && npm test --workspace client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
